description: Metro Station Maps is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides WCAG 2.0 compliant wayfinding maps for 13 Metro Stations along the Metro North West Line, including 8 new metro stations and 5 upgraded stations. Metro services are high-frequency, driverless trains, which can quickly take you between stations operating every 4 minutes in peak times. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Local area map, M1, Metro City to Sydenham, Metro North West, Metro North West and Bankstown Line. It offers 27 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
